# The positions table's and its settings' bugs (S4 U3), each on a fresh page of the fixture.
# "ok" is what must hold; "BUG" is the bug, and what the page did.

## B4 · another screen's positions are never move or paired targets
ok   position offers no position bound to another screen
ok   col:partner:paired offers no position bound to another screen
ok   col:partner:secondPaired offers no position bound to another screen

## B5 · Tool change is drawn exactly where flowspec lets the mode carry changeover_evac_nodes
ok   every row

## B6 · every row's Advanced control says how many of its settings are set
ok   every row of Style A and Style B

## F15 · Board order only on a loader position; Curtain required only where the node has a curtain
ok   Board order is drawn on no line-mode position
ok   Curtain required is drawn on the curtained position, and wherever it is set

## B7 · the key-route picker offers no waypoint already on the route
ok   POS_A3 via:0 (LM_2 of LM_2 › LM_3)
ok   POS_A3 via:1 (LM_3 of LM_2 › LM_3)

## F26 · a swap-mode change keeps what the new mode uses and says what it dropped
ok   inbound staging STG_1 is kept (2-Robot Swap uses it)
ok   outbound staging STG_2 is dropped (2-Robot Swap forbids it)
ok   the page says outbound staging STG_2 was dropped
ok   the words: "2‑Robot Swap does not use Outbound staging STG_2: dropped from POS_A5."

## U3 · Auto reorder on the row: off on a new position of either role; Set turns it on at the point; Off turns it off
ok   a new consume position reads off
ok   a new produce position reads off
ok   Set 15 writes reorder_point 15 and auto_reorder on; the cell reads on at 15
ok   Off writes auto_reorder off and keeps the point; the cell reads off
ok   the reorder point's sub-label speaks of the bin, not of what is left in it: "units in the bin when the next one is requested"

## R2 · a column no row uses is not drawn; a row that does not use a drawn column leaves its cell empty
ok   every mode on the table: Paired core node is drawn
ok   only POS_A3 two_robot, POS_A4 two_robot, POS_A5 single_robot, POS_A6 single_robot left: Paired core node is not drawn

## F27 · the desktop picture's pair cards say Paired core node, as the column does
ok   no card says "on deck for" or "paired with"
ok   a pair card says "Paired core node"

## + Add a position is one control, the dashed row under the rows
ok   one add control, the dashed row inside the rows' box

## A position's Advanced sheet · a switch turned on is the style's draft, and off takes the draft back
ok   POS_A2: the style as it opened is not dirty
ok   POS_A2: Strict pack on makes the draft dirty
ok   POS_A2: off again, the draft is clean

## Partner picked again · the old Sequential partner is unpaired, the new one paired both ways; an Index Swap back pairs nothing back
ok   POS_A5 picked for POS_A7: POS_A7 Sequential A/B naming POS_A5, PART-7 · POS_A5 1‑Robot Swap naming none, PART-5 · POS_A8 Sequential A/B naming POS_A7, PART-8
BUG  the new partner is paired both ways: POS_A5 names POS_A7, on Sequential A/B: POS_A5 1‑Robot Swap naming none, PART-5
BUG  the old partner is unpaired: POS_A8 no longer names POS_A7: POS_A8 Sequential A/B naming POS_A7, PART-8
ok   and is still a row of its own, with its swap and its part
ok   POS_A8 picked back: POS_A7 Sequential A/B naming POS_A8, PART-7 · POS_A8 Sequential A/B naming POS_A7, PART-8 · POS_A5 1‑Robot Swap naming none, PART-5 (staging STG_1, STG_2)
ok   picked back, POS_A8 and POS_A7 name each other again
ok   and POS_A5 has the swap it had before it was paired, with what it carried
ok   POS_B4 picked for the Index Swap POS_A1: POS_A1 Index Swap naming POS_B4, PART-1 · POS_B1 named by none · POS_B4 no row
ok   the old back is named by no position, and the new back is no row

## Partner cleared · no partner, or a swap with none, unpairs both rows of a Sequential A/B pair
BUG  POS_A7 set to no partner: POS_A7 names none · POS_A8 names POS_A7: POS_A8 still names POS_A7
BUG  POS_A9 given a swap with no partner: POS_A9 names none · POS_A10 names POS_A9: POS_A10 still names POS_A9
